prompt: Create a landscape 1440x1000 high-fidelity desktop SaaS screen comp for Showoff customer sign-in. It must unmistakably be an interactive sign-in page, not a poster, no browser frame. Compose a warm ivory form sheet with a narrow three-step progress rail, a wide central form, and a narrow next-step counterfoil. Use restrained service-docket structure: numbered fields, perforation between form and counterfoil, precise ink typography. Palette #f5f2e9, #171b21, #14375a, #bd3b33. The only allowed visible text is exactly these strings: SHOWOFF, 01 ACCOUNT, 02 WORKSPACE, 03 TEAM, SIGN IN TO SHOWOFF, Continue with Google, Continue with Apple, OR, Email, Password, Continue, Create account, NEXT, Set up your workspace, Add your team. Do not add any other letters, words, labels, taglines, feature claims, decorative microcopy, data, names, prices, or numbers. No existing session or organization is implied. The central form has two clearly outlined provider buttons, email and password fields, a strong red Continue button, and a small Create account link. Counterfoil lists only Set up your workspace and Add your team; steps 02 and 03 appear quieter than active account step 01. Keep UI readable and content-led; no decorative images, no fake customer data, no dashboard cards, no texture-heavy paper. Professional calm interface with a mobile-stackable modular layout.
